title: Workspace
privateDefault: New pages are accessible only to you.
emptyIntro: Only pages this account is allowed to read are shown here.
emptyGuest: No pages have been shared with you. Ask a page manager for access.
selectPage: Select a page from the sidebar.
boundary: Choose a page in this workspace to start writing.
draftNote: Unsaved edits are kept only in this tab.
created: A page accessible only to you was created.
unsupported: This block type cannot be edited here. Its content will be preserved.
nested: Child blocks cannot be edited here. Their original content will be preserved.
confirmDiscard: Changes in this tab have not been saved. Continuing will discard your current edits.
conflict: Your edits are kept in this tab. Saving is blocked until you reload. Copy anything you need before choosing Reload from server.
loadFailed: The page could not be loaded. Your current edits have been kept.
listFailed: The page list could not be loaded.
saveFailed: The page could not be saved. Your edits have been kept. Check your connection and try again.
createFailed: The page could not be created. It will not be sent again automatically. Refresh the list to check the result.
unauthorized: Your session could not be verified. Edits are kept in this tab. Sign in again from the account screen.
forbidden: This action is unavailable. Your access may have changed. Edits are kept in this tab.
notFound: This page or workspace cannot be opened. It may not exist, or you may not have access.
disabled: Accounts are not available on this server.
unverified: Verify your email address before opening a workspace.
invalidWorkspace: No workspace was selected. Choose one from the account screen.
unavailable: The server could not be reached. Try again from the account screen.
tooLarge: The page is too large to save. Shorten the content and try again.
invalidContent: This content could not be saved. Check the title and body.
confirmReload: A successful reload will replace unsaved edits in this tab. Your edits will be kept if reloading fails.
appearanceHint: Settings are saved on this device for your account. Changing the theme resets your custom colors.
fontHint: Additional fonts are not bundled. Fonts not installed on this device fall back to a system font.
preferenceFailed: Appearance settings could not be saved.
permissionNote: Only pages you are allowed to read appear in the list.
requestBusy: Please wait for the current request to finish.
createConflict: The page list has changed. Keep a copy of this title, close this dialog, refresh the list, and try creating the page again.
blockKeys: ↑ ↓ to select, Enter to confirm, Esc to close
textTooLong: Each block can contain up to 100000 characters.
originalCellsHint: These are the strings from the import. Editing values does not change this reference data.
noOriginalCells: This row has no original imported cell values.
emptyRecords: There are no rows available to display.
tableSaveHint: Save property changes for each item with Save values. This is separate from saving the page body.
recordConflict: The table has changed on the server. Your values are kept and resubmission is stopped. Copy any values you need before confirming a reload from the server.
recordSaveFailed: The row could not be saved. Your input has been kept. Check the connection and try again.
recordUnavailable: The properties for this row are currently unavailable. Access to properties can differ from access to its body.
collectionUnavailable: The table properties could not be loaded. Check your access and connection. The page body is available.
linksEdited: The text changed, so links in this block will be saved as text. Targets from the old text are no longer shown.
attachmentsHint: Download an attachment using its file name. Current page permissions apply when it is opened.
searchScope: Search saved page titles and content this account can read. Unsaved edits and trash are excluded.
searchTruncated: Showing the first 100 results. Refine your search terms.
searchFailed: Search could not be completed. Check the terms and try again.
trashScope: Only deleted groups you can manage are shown. Restoring a group brings back pages deleted together. Nothing is permanently deleted here.
trashEmpty: There are no pages available to restore.
trashFailed: Trash could not be loaded. Check your connection and account.
pageOperationHint: Moving or trashing requires permission to manage the page and its entire affected subtree.
manageRequired: Permission to manage this page is required.
recordCannotMove: A table row page cannot be moved or restored outside its original table.
moveCycle: A page cannot be moved into itself or one of its descendants.
lastPageManager: This action would leave a page without a manager.
movePageHint: Move this page and its descendants. Review the destination and permission inheritance before continuing.
trashPageHint: Move this page and its active descendants to trash. They can be restored later.
restorePageHint: Restore this deleted group. Child pages deleted in a separate earlier action are not restored.
inheritPermissions: Inherit permissions from the destination parent
inheritPermissionsHint: Inheritance is off by default. Existing direct grants are kept. Enabling inheritance may change who can read through the destination parent.
operationConflict: The destination changed. Nothing is sent again automatically. Refresh the list and review the action.
operationAccessChanged: This action is unavailable. The account, page or destination access may have changed. Your input has been kept.
operationUncertain: The result could not be confirmed. Nothing is sent again automatically. Check the page list and trash.
operationResultCheck: The page state changed. Check the page list and trash, then choose the action again if needed.
operationReviewed: The latest list has been checked. Review the destination and inheritance before continuing.
exportScope: Export saved active pages and table rows this account can currently read. This is separate from notes stored on this device.
exportLimitations: Attachments are a manifest of names and sizes only; file contents are not included. Permissions, trash, history and sessions are excluded. This is not a full backup.
exportCsvSafety: The ZIP also contains original values in content.json. Formula-like CSV values and leading whitespace receive an apostrophe prefix to prevent execution by spreadsheet software.
exportUnsaved: This tab has unsaved edits. The export uses the version saved on the server.
exportStarted: Download started. Check the destination in your browser.
exportTooLarge: The export exceeds the 16 MiB limit.
exportFailed: The export could not be created. Check your connection and account.
historyUnavailable: Editor history is unavailable for this page. Your current input has been kept.
heading: Heading
dividerEmptyOnly: Only an empty block can be converted to a divider.
saveBeforeBlockMove: Cross-page moves use blocks saved on the server. Save the current body, or discard unsaved edits to use the saved version. Unsaved table values must be saved separately.
crossBlockMoveHint: Both pages must still have the reviewed versions and editing permissions. The selection moves together. Cross-page moves are outside this editor’s local Undo.
blockNotSaved: This block is not in the saved version. Save it before moving.
blockMoveFailed: The block could not be moved. Your content has been kept. Check the destination and connection.
blockAttachmentsUnsupported: This block references a page-bound attachment, so it cannot move to another page. It can still be reordered within this page.
blockMoved: Block moved. The saved source page has been reloaded.
roomOffHint: Start coediting explicitly from a saved page.
roomIntro: Sync the title and text, block additions, removal and movement, text formatting and undo of your own actions. Supporting servers also sync checklist values, paragraph splits and merges, and ordinary block types. Stop coediting to edit table values, column layouts or the types of original code and divider blocks.
roomFocusPolicy: Periodic sync keeps input fields in place and waits during composition. On supporting servers, Enter splits a paragraph and Backspace at its start merges it. Shift+Enter adds a line within the paragraph.
roomNoPresence: Other people’s cursors and presence are not shown yet.
roomSaveFirst: There are unsaved changes or a conflict. Save or review your input before reloading. Starting never uploads or discards existing unsaved input.
roomReviewIntro: The server content differs from the page you started with. Each text preview shows the first 3,000 characters. Open the server content, or cancel to keep your current display.
roomStartFailed: Coediting could not start. Your input is preserved. Check connection, access and server support; reload saved content if needed.
roomStopFirst: Stop coediting before using this action.
roomInputStopped: Sync has stopped and your input is kept in this tab. An expired connection or changed access/content does not trigger automatic reconnection or a switch to normal saving. Review your input before choosing what to do.
roomStopPending: Some input has not been confirmed saved. Sync the same input before stopping, or stop while keeping it in this tab. Kept input is never automatically passed to normal saving.
roomStoppedClean: Coediting stopped. The body and title now use normal autosave.
roomCopyHint: Copy any needed title and text before reloading the latest server content.
roomBoundary: During coediting, the title and existing text sync periodically. Stop coediting before changing structure or properties.
roomLimitedSync: Periodic text, block and formatting sync
roomDraftHint: Input waiting to send stays in this tab. Confirm saving using the Synced status.
roomStoppedHint: Review and copy any input you need before reloading the latest content.
blockCommentSaveFirst: Save this new block before adding a comment.
attachmentSaveFirst: Save your changes or explicitly reload them before opening attachments.
attachmentStopRoom: Review coediting input and return to regular editing before opening attachments.
publicationSaveFirst: Save changes before reviewing text for publication.
publicationStopRoom: Stop collaboration before reviewing text for publication.
inline.invalidLink: Enter a valid http or https address.
inline.singleBlockOnly: Select text within one block to change formatting.
inline.openLink: Open web link in a new tab
inline.hint: Select text to format it. Ctrl / ⌘ + B, I, U and K are also available.
inline.roomDisabled: Text formatting and block additions, removal and movement within this page are supported. Enter adds a line within the block. Stop coediting to split or merge blocks, change types, add people or page references, or change column layouts.
roomOperationConflict: A concurrent move could not be applied. Its blocks remain at their last valid position. Check the current layout.
roomCapacity: This room has reached its capacity. Save any needed draft JSON, then restart coediting from saved content.
roomResetConfirm: Start a new room from the content saved on the server. Coediting in other tabs will stop. Pending actions in this tab will not carry over; download the draft JSON first if needed.
inline.error: Check the selection or formatting limit.
nesting.keyboardHint: Indent or outdent one block with Tab / Shift+Tab. Press Esc then Tab to move to the next control. Up to 8 levels are editable.
nesting.singleBlock: Change the structure of one block at a time. Keep the selection within one block.
nesting.readOnly: This block structure cannot be changed. Source text and unsupported content are preserved.
nesting.limit: Up to 8 nesting levels are editable. Outdent a block first.
nesting.noPrevious: There is no previous block to indent under.
nesting.atRoot: This block is already at the outermost level.
nesting.unsupportedParent: This block type cannot contain child blocks.
nesting.mergeChildren: Blocks with children cannot be joined. Move the children first.
nesting.mergeUnsupported: These adjacent blocks cannot be joined.
nesting.failed: The block could not be changed. Check its content and position.
nesting.legacyDepth: Existing content deeper than 8 levels is preserved as read only.
nesting.deleteChildren: Delete this block and its {count} child blocks? You can undo before saving.
inline.referenceError: The page reference could not be changed. Check access and retry.
localeFallbackNotice: Some labels use English. Page names and content are not translated.
typedColumns: Enter values for each field type. Calculated results are read-only.
recordInvalidValue: Check the field values. Incomplete input has been kept.
recordUnknown: The save result is unknown. Your input is kept and saving is stopped. Reload to check.
recordPeopleUnavailable: Assignee choices could not be loaded. Saved references are kept.
roomRenewRetry: Connection renewal will retry. Your input is kept.
collectionChanged: Properties changed while loading this page. Reload to review the latest values.
roomSyncRetry: Sync will retry. Input waiting to send is kept.
roomWaitingInput: Waiting for composition and input to finish.
saveUnknown: The save result could not be confirmed. Your latest input remains in this tab and automatic resending has stopped. Copy anything you need before reloading to check the server version.
autoSaveHint: The title and body save automatically after you type. You can keep writing while saving. Save properties with each row’s Save button. Unsaved input remains in this tab; check the save status before closing.
blockMove.hint: Drag the left handle to move a block and its children. Hold the handle briefly on a touch screen. You can also use the block menu to choose a destination.
blockMove.dialogHint: Move the text, formatting, and child blocks together. The change is saved automatically and can be undone.
blockMove.cycle: A block cannot be moved into its own descendants.
blockDnd.handle: Drag to move. Click or press Enter for block actions.
blockDnd.instructions: Drag the block handle to move the block and its children. On a touch screen, hold the handle briefly, then drag. With the handle focused, press Space to pick up, use the arrow keys to adjust the position, and press Space to drop. Escape cancels. Enter opens block actions, including Move within this page.
blockDnd.started: Picked up {text}. Use the arrow keys to choose a destination, Space to drop, or Escape to cancel.
blockDnd.canceled: Move canceled. The block is unchanged.
blockDnd.unavailable: Drag could not start. Open block actions and choose Move within this page.
blockDnd.page: Move to page {target}. Review and confirm before moving.
bodyEntry.label: Page body
blockSelection.title: Block selection
blockSelection.hint: Use Shift with a checkbox to select a range. Move the selected blocks and their children within this page or to another page.
blockSelection.dialogHint: Move {count} selected blocks in document order, including their children, formatting, and references. The change saves automatically and can be undone in one step.
blockSelection.noChange: Choose a destination that changes the position.
blockSelection.destination: The destination cannot be inside the selected blocks or their children.
blockSelection.invalid: Review the selected blocks and select them again.
blockSelection.crossPage: Review the selection before moving it together to another page.
mention.label: Mention a person, page or date
mention.hint: Use arrows and Enter to select. Mentions are references; email and reminders are not sent.
mention.editorHint: Type @ to insert a person, page or date.
columns.unwrapHint: Restore blocks from left to right, preserving their content and formatting. Undo restores the layout.
columns.invalid: The column structure could not be verified. No changes were made.
columns.crossPage: Columns and their children can move to another page. Nested columns are not supported.
columns.resizeMergeHint: Move the third column's content to the end of the second column, preserving its order, content, formatting and references.
columns.resizeAddHint: Add an empty third column on the right. Existing columns and content are preserved.
columns.resizeMoveCount: Move {roots} root blocks, containing {blocks} blocks in total.
columns.resizeEmpty: The third column is empty. Only its empty wrapper will be removed.
columns.resizeUndo: One Undo restores the previous layout. Changes use normal autosave.
columns.resizeChanged: The page, input or access changed during review. Nothing was changed. Close and review again.
roomPresenceIntro: Show participants and cursors in the body. Presence is temporary and disappears after leaving or losing the connection.
roomPresence.label: Coediting participants
roomPresence.unavailable: Participant display is unavailable. Text synchronization continues.
roomPresence.schema: Participant display needs a server schema migration. Text synchronization continues.
settingsDialog.title: Settings
settingsDialog.working: Wait for the current action to finish
settingsDialog.unavailable: Settings could not be loaded. Close and try again.
blockTransfer.count: Move {count} selected blocks with their children, columns, formatting and references.
blockTransfer.notAllowed: This content cannot move to that location. The original body is retained.
blockTransfer.depth: The move would exceed eight nesting levels. Choose another parent.
blockTransfer.readOnly: Read-only content or retained import source cannot be moved as part of this selection.
blockTransfer.unknown: The move result could not be confirmed. Your input was retained without an automatic retry. Reload to check.
blockTransfer.refreshFailed: The move was saved, but the view could not be refreshed. Reload the page.
workspacePicker.title: Switch workspace
workspacePicker.createHint: Start with yourself as the only owner. Invite members whenever you are ready.
workspacePicker.name: Workspace name
workspacePicker.slugHint: Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
workspacePicker.accountChanged: The signed-in account changed. Close and check your account.
workspacePicker.invalidResponse: The response could not be verified. Close and reload the list.
workspacePicker.invalidSlug: Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens for the URL name.
workspacePicker.rateLimited: Wait a moment before trying again.
workspacePicker.createUnconfirmed: Creation could not be confirmed. Check the account list before creating again.
workspacePicker.discardMessage: Discard the workspace creation form and continue?
teamspaces.title: Teamspaces
teamspaces.createPageHint: Create a page in {name}. Participants receive access according to the teamspace settings.
teamspaces.saveBeforeMove: Save the body before reviewing access changes.
teamspaces.moveHint: Review changes to access, including child pages, on the next screen. Existing individual grants remain.
teamspaces.preservedReaders: Readers retaining individual or other access
teamspaces.preserveGrants: Existing individual grants remain. Removing a teamspace does not necessarily make the page private.
teamspaces.ownersFull: Teamspace owners can manage sharing and edit placed pages. Explicit denies and children with inheritance disabled take precedence.
teamspaces.confirmAccess: I reviewed the displayed access changes
teamspaces.moveChanged: The page, membership or permissions changed. Reload and review access again.
teamspaces.moveFailed: The move could not be reviewed. The body was not changed.
teamspaces.moveUnknown: The move result could not be confirmed. Reload to check its saved state before trying again.
teamspaces.heldInput: Input was retained and autosave paused because permissions or saved content changed. Review your input before reloading the page.
teamspaces.refreshed: Permissions checked. Continue with your input preserved.
teamspaces.refreshFailed: Placement was saved, but the view could not be refreshed. Reload the page.
teamspaces.loseRead: After this move, you will no longer be able to read the affected page.
teamspaces.loseManage: After this move, you will no longer be able to manage sharing for the affected page.
teamspaces.createUnknown: Page creation could not be confirmed. Close and check the list and saved state before creating again.
simpleTable.label: Table
simpleTable.header: Use the first row as a header
simpleTable.confirmDeleteRow: Delete row {number} and all content entered in this row?
simpleTable.confirmDeleteColumn: Delete column {number} and all content entered in this column?
simpleTable.limit: Table limit reached: 256 rows, 32 columns, 4096 characters per cell and 100,000 total characters. The input was not saved.
simpleTable.error: The table could not be changed. Current content was preserved.
simpleTable.roomReadOnly: This table is read-only during collaboration. End collaboration to edit it.
clipboard.paused: The upload paused. Check its status to continue.
clipboard.cancelled: Stopped remaining uploads. Attachments already added are kept.
clipboard.unavailable: This attachment was removed or you no longer have permission to view it.
clipboard.imageError: The image preview is unavailable. Download it using the file name.
clipboard.fileLimit: Attach up to 20 files, 16 MiB per file and 32 MiB in total.
clipboard.disabled: Attachments are unavailable in this workspace. Ask an administrator to configure file storage.
clipboard.changed: Saved content changed. Your input is kept. Stop the upload and review the saved page.
clipboard.accessChanged: Your login or edit access changed. Your input is kept.
clipboard.invalidTable: This table could not be read. Select a smaller range and paste again.
clipboard.failed: The paste could not finish. Your existing content is kept.
clipboard.filesInCell: Paste files and images in the page body, outside the table.
clipboard.saveProperties: Save property changes before pasting attachments.
clipboard.pageLimit: This page is too large to add more content. Paste into another page.
clipboard.storageLimit: The storage limit has been reached. Remove unused attachments or contact an administrator.
blocks.noHeadings: Add headings to show a table of contents here.
pageTools.coverHint: Choose an image attached to this page.
pageTools.locked: Editing is locked for this page.
pageTools.lockHint: The lock prevents accidental edits. Anyone with editing access can unlock it. Sharing permissions stay the same.
pageTools.privateCopy: Copy the content and attachments to a page only you can open. Sharing settings and person notifications are not copied.
pageTools.uncertain: The result could not be confirmed. Refresh the page list before trying again.
pageTools.collectionCopy: Copying pages that include databases is not supported yet.
clipboard.cutDone: Selected blocks cut. Paste to move them.
clipboard.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the blocks and press Ctrl+C or ⌘C. The original content is preserved.
clipboard.unsupported: The selection contains a block that cannot be copied. Change the selection and try again.
clipboard.attachmentPage: Copies containing attachments can be pasted within the same page. Attach the files again on another page.
blockSelection.keyboardHint: Press Esc to select a block, then Shift+↑↓ to extend. Use Ctrl/⌘+C, X and V to copy, cut and paste, or Ctrl/⌘+D to duplicate.
